Global Campaign Rules

Applies to all 5 products
01

Show it working

Demonstrate the tool doing something real on camera. Active demos drive clicks far more than static unboxings.

02

Show it in action

Pick up the tool. Use it on something real — a screw, a seatbelt, a tag. Hands-on content outperforms talking-head reviews every time.

03

Your voice, your story

Speak from your real experience. AI-generated scripts for inspiration are OK — AI-generated video is not. Sound like you.

Avoid

  • Medical or safety guarantees of any kind
  • AI-generated video of any kind
  • Competitor brand names
  • Vague claims without a real demo (“it's amazing” without showing why)

Always include

  • At least one tool demonstrated live on camera
  • “Made in the USA” — audiences love this
  • 25-year warranty — huge credibility signal
